description: This file is a Markdown document that provides instructional content and code examples for API testing using Playwright in C#. It includes explanations, sample code snippets for setting up API requests, creating and deleting repositories/issues on GitHub, and testing server states through API calls and UI interactions.

classes.name: TestGitHubAPI
classes.description: A sample test class demonstrating how to perform API testing on GitHub using Playwright's C# bindings, including setup, teardown, and test methods for creating issues.

methods.name: SetUpAPITesting
methods.description: Initializes the API request context and creates a test repository on GitHub before tests run.

methods.name: CreateAPIRequestContext
methods.description: Configures and creates a new APIRequestContext with the necessary headers and base URL for GitHub API access.

methods.name: CreateTestRepository
methods.description: Creates a new repository on GitHub for testing purposes.

methods.name: TearDownAPITesting
methods.description: Deletes the test repository and disposes of the request context after tests complete.

methods.name: DeleteTestRepository
methods.description: Deletes the test GitHub repository used for testing.
